decisive_items: Third-degree atrioventricular block with ventricular rate of 48 beats/min
Wide QRS complex tachycardia at 173 beats/min with R morphology in lead V1 and left-axis deviation
response.rationale: The LMNA pathogenic variant plus early conduction disease, ventricular tachycardia, and atrial fibrillation is diagnostic of lamin A/C cardiomyopathy. R4 is a synonymous label but less canonical; the other candidates are ECG manifestations or are contradicted by normal LV size and function.

rejected.why: Third-degree AV block is a manifestation of the underlying LMNA cardiomyopathy, not the unifying diagnosis.
Normal left ventricle size and ejection fraction contradict dilated cardiomyopathy; the mild left atrial enlargement and elevated NT-proBNP are nonspecific.
Wide QRS tachycardia alone is not specific for ARVC, and there are no right ventricular structural or ARVC-typical ECG criteria; the LMNA variant better explains the phenotype.
Atrial fibrillation is one of the arrhythmic manifestations of the underlying cardiomyopathy, not the most likely diagnosis.
